title: Deceiver experiment (Findings 4.9)
description: 24 all-Opus (medium) games, with player 3 playing the Deceiver profile (shared role v2 + Deceiver v4). Cycle seating over seeds 137–160. 12 games were planned, and the run was extended to 24 afterwards. Judged with codebook v1.8. The Deceiver won 13 of 24.
